Brand & Community Project

The Dandies Project

An original project honoring men of color: a tabletop book, lookbooks, video and release parties.

Client
IAmMoody original
Service
Brand & Community Project
When
2014–2017
Where
Minneapolis
See the full series

The idea

Highlight the positive impact of men of color in their own communities, with a sense of purpose and a sense of style.

What we produced

A photo shoot and tabletop book, a book launch at Coup d'état Uptown, yearly lookbooks and video, and launch events with silent auctions, including the 2017 kickoff at Urban Eatery and lookbook release at 514 Studio.

Recognition

The project was featured by Mshale and KFAI, among other press.
